argv: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $base='http://127.0.0.1:17448'; $before=Invoke-RestMethod ($base+'/api/health') -TimeoutSec 6; Write-Output ('BEFORE='+$before.state); Write-Output ('BEFORE_REASONS='+(@($before.reasons) -join ',')); try{$chat=Invoke-RestMethod ($base+'/api/supervisor-watchdog/managed-chats?inspect=1') -TimeoutSec 18;Write-Output ('MANAGED_INSPECT='+([string]$chat.inspected));Write-Output ('MANAGED_COUNT='+@($chat.chats).Count);Write-Output ('MANAGED_PROVIDER_ERRORS='+@($chat.chats|Where-Object {$_.providerLoadError}).Count)}catch{Write-Output 'MANAGED_INSPECT_ERROR'}; try{$control=Invoke-RestMethod ($base+'/api/projects/control-plane?inspect=1') -TimeoutSec 22;Write-Output ('CONTROL_CONFLICTS='+@($control.conflicts).Count);Write-Output ('CONTROL_AGENTS='+@($control.agents).Count)}catch{Write-Output 'CONTROL_INSPECT_ERROR'}; $after=Invoke-RestMethod ($base+'/api/health') -TimeoutSec 6; Write-Output ('AFTER='+$after.state); Write-Output ('AFTER_REASONS='+(@($after.reasons) -join ',')); foreach($name in @('git_baseline','browser_cdp')){$r=$after.components.$name;Write-Output ($name+'_STATE='+$r.state);Write-Output ($name+'_AGE_MS='+$r.ageMs);Write-Output ($name+'_FAILURES='+$r.consecutiveFailures)}
